test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Enzymes can ______ starches into sugars and proteins into amino acids.
solution: The correct answer is **"convert."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Convert"** is the correct word to fill in the blank. • This sentence **talks**__ about what enzymes can do to starches and proteins. • **"Convert"** means to change something into a different form or state. (एक रूप, पद्घति या उपयोग-प्रकार से दूसरे में परिवर्तन करना, बदलना) __ • **Example:** *We **converted**__ our oil furnace to gas to save money.* • In this case, enzymes can change starches into sugars and proteins into amino acids. • The correct answer is option 2. **Correct sentence**: *Enzymes can __**convert**__ starches into sugars and proteins into amino acids. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Cover"** means to put something over or on top of something else. (छिपाने या बचाने के लिए ढकना) • **"Covert"** means secret or hidden. (गुप्‍त, छिपकर किया गया) • **"Conserve"** means to protect something from harm or damage. (बरबाद होने से बचाना, संरक्षण करना) 205:T5a0, Here, the erroneous part is **"as well, WHO says."**
